audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Covenant memory, ancestors, Egypt, Joseph, plagues, exodus, land, and historical retelling.

verses.restored: O give thanks to YHWH; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

familiar.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

modern.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.

original.text: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: Sing to him, sing psalms to him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

familiar.text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

modern.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.

original.text: שִֽׁירוּ ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek YHWH.

familiar.text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

modern.text: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

original.text: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Seek YHWH, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

familiar.text: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

modern.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

original.text: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד

verses.restored: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

familiar.text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

modern.text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,

original.text: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽיו

verses.restored: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

familiar.text: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

modern.text: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

original.text: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו

verses.restored: He is YHWH our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

familiar.text: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

modern.text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.

original.text: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו

verses.restored: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

familiar.text: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

modern.text: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—

original.text: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר

verses.restored: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;

familiar.text: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

modern.text: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק

verses.restored: And confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

familiar.text: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

modern.text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: Saying, To thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

familiar.text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

modern.text: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”

original.text: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

familiar.text: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

modern.text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,

original.text: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ

verses.restored: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

familiar.text: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

modern.text: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

original.text: וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר

verses.restored: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

familiar.text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

modern.text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:

original.text: לֹֽא הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים

verses.restored: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

familiar.text: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

modern.text: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”

original.text: אַֽל תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל תָּרֵֽעוּ

verses.restored: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

familiar.text: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

modern.text: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל מַטֵּה לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר

verses.restored: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

familiar.text: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

modern.text: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.

original.text: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף

verses.restored: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

familiar.text: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

modern.text: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,

original.text: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל רגליו בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: Until the time that his word came: the word of YHWH tried him.

familiar.text: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

modern.text: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.

original.text: עַד עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ

verses.restored: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

familiar.text: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

modern.text: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.

original.text: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

familiar.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

modern.text: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,

original.text: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל קִנְיָנֽוֹ

verses.restored: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

familiar.text: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

modern.text: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

original.text: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם

verses.restored: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

familiar.text: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

modern.text: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ חָֽם

verses.restored: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

familiar.text: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

modern.text: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,

original.text: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו

verses.restored: Their heart turned to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants [poetic-theological attribution].

familiar.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

notes.title: Hardening / turning hearts
notes.body: This theological retelling attributes Egyptian hostility within a providential narrative. It must not erase human agency or become a template for claiming that modern hatred, oppression, or war was divinely caused or required.

modern.text: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.

original.text: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו

verses.restored: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

familiar.text: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

modern.text: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.

original.text: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: They showed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

familiar.text: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

modern.text: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

original.text: שָֽׂמוּ בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם

verses.restored: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

familiar.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

modern.text: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.

original.text: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת דברוו

verses.restored: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

familiar.text: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

modern.text: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.

original.text: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת דְּגָתָֽם

verses.restored: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

familiar.text: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

modern.text: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.

original.text: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

familiar.text: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

modern.text: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.

original.text: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל גְּבוּלָֽם

verses.restored: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

familiar.text: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

modern.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.

original.text: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם

verses.restored: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

familiar.text: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

modern.text: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

original.text: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם

verses.restored: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

familiar.text: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

modern.text: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.

original.text: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר

verses.restored: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

familiar.text: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

modern.text: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם

verses.restored: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

familiar.text: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

modern.text: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.

original.text: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל אוֹנָֽם

verses.restored: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

familiar.text: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

modern.text: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.

original.text: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל

verses.restored: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

familiar.text: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

modern.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.

original.text: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

familiar.text: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

modern.text: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.

original.text: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה

verses.restored: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

familiar.text: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

modern.text: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

original.text: שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם

verses.restored: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

familiar.text: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

modern.text: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.

original.text: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר

verses.restored: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

familiar.text: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

modern.text: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.

original.text: כִּֽי זָ֭כַר אֶת דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

familiar.text: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

modern.text: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.

original.text: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת בְּחִירָֽיו

verses.restored: And gave them the lands of the nations: and they inherited the labour of the people;

familiar.text: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

modern.text: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ

verses.restored: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye YHWH.

familiar.text: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.

modern.text: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!

original.text: בַּעֲב֤וּר יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Plague and conquest memories must not authorize collective punishment, anti-Egyptian racism, or modern territorial dispossession.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
